items.title: Nordson’s (NASDAQ:NDSN) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates, Guides for Strong Full-Year Sales
items.summary: Manufacturing company Nordson (NASDAQ:NDSN) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.3% year on year to $817.7 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.06 billion at the midpoint came in 2.4% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.25 per share was 5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
